# `cargo cicd git status`

Surfaces a structured summary of the git working-tree state: branch, ahead/behind counts, staged/unstaged/untracked file counts, and last-commit metadata.

**Noun:** `git` &nbsp;&nbsp; **Verb:** `status`

<!-- END ggen:command-reference -->

<!-- BEGIN custom:examples -->
## Examples

```sh
cargo cicd git status
```
